canonical_id: strip only terminal _methods suffix; combine all grouped source records
sample_order: ORDER BY md5(canonical_doc_id), canonical_doc_id; first 1000 IDs
primary_community: mode of section community across all grouped source records; ties choose lowest community ID; source section labels unchanged
document_hash: SHA-256 over ordered source_doc_id, NUL, section_idx, NUL, UTF-8 text, NUL tuples
semantic_gold_scope: closed-world curated alias sets; not unrestricted human semantic truth
